## Limitations

- Popular-user/item official subset; six weeks only; not representative of all VK.
- Warm-item targets only; cold-item exclusion reported.
- Official validation week divided into two ordered halves, not the official test benchmark.
- Row order is documented chronological; exact timestamps and ties unavailable. time_ms is a compatibility ordinal, not a real timestamp.
- Prior exposures enter history by row order; no labels in history.
- Absolute ten-second watch threshold is a distinct engagement proxy, not KuaiRand or KuaiRec label.
- Single trained checkpoint; no new specialist-model comparison.
- M4 training protocol reused including variable history operators.
- Original action grid only; no new model search.
- Average precision is reported as AUPRC.
- Expected cost excludes selector CPU and RPC overhead.
- Mixtures matched on validation, not necessarily test; seed variation is not a confidence interval.
- Checkpoint selection and calibration reuse validation; test not used for policy selection.
- No serving measurements in this offline report.
